items.q: What happened in Citibank's Revlon payment error?
items.a: Unchecked boxes and an **overridden warning** sent **$900M of principal** instead of $8M of interest.

items.q: Why does Feminella say cars have brakes?
items.a: So you can **go fast** and **stop safely**: controls enable speed.

items.q: Which three agent governance approaches failed?
items.a: **Sandboxing everything**, **letting agents run wild**, and **policy docs in prompts**.

items.q: Why start with an agent registry?
items.a: **You can't govern what you can't see**: it records owner, tools and endpoints.
So a ticket summarizer doesn't wait in the **same review queue** as a **production deployer**.

items.q: How does Two Sigma limit an agent's tools?
items.a: The agent **declares the tools it needs** and policy is **enforced at start-up**.

items.q: Why does Two Sigma treat evals like unit tests?
items.a: A **model change** is a **runtime dependency change**.

items.q: What goes wrong when humans approve every agent action?
items.a: **Review fatigue**: people click yes by reflex.

items.q: What should replace a request you approve 99.99% of the time?
items.a: A **rule** the agent follows, with **classifiers** for routine calls and humans for **ambiguous** ones.

items.q: Why can't a 'wait for approval' instruction live only in the prompt?
items.a: **Context compaction** can drop it, as when an agent **deleted hundreds of emails**.
